metaDescription: Count and filter HTTP links by hostname and nofollow status on a public page.
intro: Count and filter HTTP links by hostname and nofollow status on a public page.
about: Links to the same hostname as the submitted page are counted as internal. Other hostnames, including subdomains, are counted as external. The report includes up to 500 link entries.
exampleTitle: Review outgoing links in an article
example: Scan an article and select the external filter. Review the destination and anchor text for links that should point elsewhere.

faqs.question: Does the count include every kind of link?
faqs.answer: The scan reports HTTP and HTTPS links from the fetched HTML. Fragment-only, email and telephone links are excluded.
